member.name: M:API.Controllers.AccountController.ExternalLogin(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Initiates external authentication with the specified provider (e.g., Google).
member.param: The URL to redirect to after successful authentication. Defaults to "/".
member.returns: A challenge redirect to the external provider's login page.
member.remarks: This endpoint redirects the user to the external provider's authentication page. After successful authentication, the user is redirected to the callback endpoint. Currently supported providers: Google.

member.name: M:API.Controllers.AccountController.ExternalLoginCallback(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Callback endpoint for external authentication providers.
member.param: The URL to redirect to after processing. Defaults to "/".
Error message from the external provider, if any.
member.returns: A redirect to the return URL with authentication tokens or error information.
member.remarks: This endpoint is called by the external provider after authentication. On success, it creates or links the user account and redirects with tokens. Query parameters on redirect: token, email, displayName (on success) or error, message (on failure).

member.name: M:API.Controllers.AccountController.GetExternalLogins
member.summary: Gets a list of external login providers linked to the current user's account.
member.returns: A list of linked external login providers with their details.
member.remarks: Requires authentication. Returns the login provider name, provider key, and display name for each linked external account.

member.name: M:API.Controllers.AccountController.LinkExternalLogin(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Initiates linking an external login provider to the current user's account.
member.param: The URL to redirect to after linking. Defaults to "/".
member.returns: A challenge redirect to the external provider's login page.
member.remarks: Requires authentication. Redirects to the external provider for authentication, then links the external account to the current user. Fails if the provider is already linked to this account or to another user.

member.name: M:API.Controllers.AccountController.LinkExternalLoginCallback(System.String,System.String)
member.summary: Callback endpoint for linking external login providers.
member.param: The URL to redirect to after processing. Defaults to "/".
Error message from the external provider, if any.
member.returns: A redirect to the return URL with success or error information.
member.remarks: This endpoint is called by the external provider after authentication during account linking. Query parameters on redirect: success=true, provider (on success) or error, message (on failure).

member.name: M:API.Controllers.AccountController.UnlinkExternalLogin(System.String)
member.summary: Unlinks an external login provider from the current user's account.
member.param: The external authentication provider name to unlink (e.g., "Google").
member.returns: A success message if the provider was unlinked.
member.remarks: Requires authentication. Cannot unlink the last external login if the user has no password set. Ensures the user always has at least one authentication method available.
